:::{#exm-deriv-normsq}

#### Derivative of a sum of squares

Let $\vcoef = \tp{(\coef{1}, \coef{2})}$, so $\tp{\vcoef}\vcoef = \coef{1}^2 + \coef{2}^2$.
By @cor-deriv-normsq:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef}(\tp{\vcoef}\vcoef)}_{2 \times 1}
= 2\vcoef
= \begin{pmatrix} 2\coef{1} \\ 2\coef{2} \end{pmatrix}
$$

Direct partial differentiation yields the same column vector.

:::
